title: The rider on the red horse among the myrtles (first night vision)

symbols.symbol: Man on a red horse among the myrtles
symbols.in_text_interpretation: Called "the angel of the LORD who stood among the myrtle trees" (1:11).
"Those whom the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth" (1:10).
The nations at ease, with whom the LORD is very angry (1:15).

description: A man on a red horse stands among myrtles in a hollow, with red, sorrel and white horses behind him; they report that the whole earth is at rest; the angel of the LORD asks how long the LORD will withhold mercy from Jerusalem, "with which you have had indignation these seventy years"; the LORD answers with comfort and the promise that his house will be built.
